acceptance.given: The Skill authoring standard package is available for inspection and its declaration requirements include a tests area.

oracle.expected: The parsed standard artifact contains a non-empty tests declaration that is explicitly associated with the standard's tests area.
forbidden: The tests declaration is absent or empty.
An unrelated heading is accepted as the tests declaration.
oracle.observable: The artifact check reports the tests declaration and its associated standard section.

acceptance.then: The standard artifact check reports the tests definition as present and correctly associated with the tests area.
acceptance.when: The planned A01 test parses the standard artifact and evaluates the required tests declaration.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 against a disposable standard artifact with the required tests declaration removed; the check must fail while identifying the missing tests definition.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Skill authoring standard to declare its tests area explicitly and make that declaration observable to the artifact check.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback removes the newly authored standard document and its tests declaration.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from an undefined tests declaration to an explicitly authored tests section that can be checked from parsed artifact content.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A01 test and the terminal Skill-authoring validation selection pass, with the artifact check confirming the explicit tests declaration and the negative case identifying its absence.
